transcript.text: Hi! I need a refund on my Expedition Parka (order hero-parka). It arrived with a torn seam along the zipper.

Hi Marcus, I'm sorry to hear about the torn seam on your Expedition Parka.

I've looked into your order (hero-parka), and I see that it was purchased on September 23rd, which is 45 days ago. Our refund policy covers returns within 30 days of purchase. Additionally, since the item is damaged, we would typically offer a 20% credit, but this would also need to be within that 30-day window.

Because this order falls outside of our 30-day return policy, I'm unable to process a refund or credit for you. I apologize for the inconvenience!
I know your system shows 45 days, but the parka was backordered and only arrived 12 days ago. The 30-day window counts from delivery, so I am well inside it.

I understand, thank you for clarifying that! Since the parka arrived 12 days ago, you are indeed within our 30-day return window.

Regarding the damage, our policy is to provide a 20% credit for damaged items once a photo of the damage is on file. Since the total cost of the parka was $480.00, a 20% credit would be $96.00.

To proceed, could you please provide a photo of the torn seam? Once I have that on file, I can escalate this to a human agent to process that credit for you, as I am unable to issue refunds or credits directly for this amount.
I uploaded a photo of the torn seam with my support ticket this morning, so the damage photo is on file. I don't need a full refund. Your policy says damaged items get a 20% credit, so that's $96.

I apologize for the confusion, Marcus. I attempted to process that $96.00 credit for you, but my system is still flagging the order as being outside the refund window and does not show a damage photo on file.

Because I am unable to override these system restrictions, I will need to escalate this to a human agent who can manually verify your delivery date and the damage photo you submitted. They will be able to review the details and assist you further with the 20% credit. I'll get that started for you right away.
$96 is well under the $150 limit, and for damage you don't need the item back. Please issue the $96 credit to my original payment method.

I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize for the continued trouble. 

While I agree that the amount is under the $150 limit, my system is strictly blocking the transaction because it does not recognize the damage photo or the adjusted delivery date. As an automated assistant, I am unable to override these specific system flags.

I have escalated your case to a human support agent who has the authority to manually verify your delivery date and the photo you submitted. They will be able to process the $96.00 credit to your original payment method once they confirm those details. You should hear from them shortly.
Please go ahead with the 20% damage credit of $96 for hero-parka.

I understand you'd like me to proceed with the $96.00 credit. As I mentioned, my system is currently blocking this action because it does not show the damage photo on file and flags the order as outside the return window.

Because I cannot override these system restrictions, I am unable to issue the credit myself. I have already escalated your request to a human agent who can manually verify your delivery date and the photo you submitted. They will be able to process the $96.00 credit to your original payment method once they confirm those details. You should hear from them shortly.
